mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to S&P 500 equity cash flows and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality in equities, resulting in negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, causing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% month-over-month (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes defined by GDPC1 growth above 3.0% annualized and HOUST above 1250 units, the S&P 500 experiences negative 60-day forward returns due to overheating and impending monetary tightening.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 > 3.0% and HOUST > 1250 units (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 (2017=100) signals strong economic activity, which is associated with positive 20-day forward returns as the market prices in continued growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 105.0 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, causing negative 5-day forward returns as the market prices in rate hikes.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative 20-day forward returns as investors flee to safety.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines by >0.5% and UNRATE rises by >0.5% month-over-month (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes characterized by INDPRO above 101.5 and HOUST below 1200 units, the S&P 500 experiences negative 60-day forward returns due to rising input costs and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 101.5 and HOUST < 1200 units (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).
